The quality assurance and control analysis included the following four measurements: 1. Equilibrium CO capacity, measured by simulating DAC and desorption over at least four cycles in 2 a fixed bed screening reactor 2. BET surface area measured via N sorption using a Micromeritics ASAP 2020 adsorption analyzer 2 3. Mass yield calculated based on mass of the batch before and after the synthesis 4. Available amine capture sites measured via titration of amine sites The QA/QC was conducted randomly on 9 of the 20 batches. No significant deviations were observed. The average equilibrium CO capture capacity was 1.35 ± 0.09 mmol/g across all batches measured, which was 2 the expected capacity for the ECCOsorb-T1 sorbent. The amine loading on the sorbent was measured by NaOH titration and is summarized in Figure 8. The amine loading shows no significant batch to batch deviations or outliers. The synthesized sorbent was then dried, combined, and packaged for delivery to the commercial partner. Figure 8. Measured amine sites using titration with NaOH. Batch numbers represent 2.5 kg batch of ECCOsorb-T1 synthesize, where Batch 1 was the first and Batch 20 is the last. Pleated filter manufacturing Once the sorbent was received, the commercial partner began trial runs of the sorbent coating to optimize homogeneity of the sorbent layers and maximize loading from the pilot manufacturing line. After coating, approximately half of the flat filter sheets were cut and trimmed to size, pleated, and framed into the filter panels. Ten pleated filter panels were provided to Susteon. The as received pleated filter panel is shown in Figure 9. Ten flat sheet laminates were also provided to Susteon. Final Technical Report – Unlimited Rights Data 14 Susteon Inc. Task 3 – Bench-Scale System Design and Fabrication The 1 kg CO /day bench DAC unit, originally constructed as part of DE-FE0032118, was modified and 2 updated to accommodate the structured sorbent filter testing as part of the current project work. A new DAC enclosure, shown in Figure 10, was fabricated to house sorbent coated filter panels with sufficient gas seals and electrical feedthroughs to Joule heat the panel for sorbent regeneration. The new enclosure can accommodate up to three pleated filter panels arranged in series.
